Title: Java Developer 
 Location: Salem OR 
 Duration: 6 Month Contract 
 Job Description 
 The primary purpose of this position is to participate in the design, development and maintenance of the ORESTAR application, utilizing a variety of tools including Java, Struts II, Java Scripting, and PL/SQL. 
 Systems Development and Planning 
 · Independently analyze diverse system narrative statements, complex customer requirements and business rules; translate them into functional system and/or program specifications; and capture functional and design requirements. Recommend options to best utilize application development software as well as ways to utilize technologies to maximize future organizational benefits. 
 · Develop, enhance, maintain, and document application programs using agency development tools and technologies in the areas of data processing, office automation, records management, and financial and accounting systems. Responsible for performance tuning of various system components and resolution of system problems. Provide application security programming to protect SoS and client information. Assess new technologies, and translate and re-orient internal business applications into browser-based applications. 
 · Ensure configuration management processes are followed for development code. Integrate applications between agencies and programs. Coordinate with business staff, communications and publishing staff, and network staff for coding extensions to network and web service facilities. 
 · Reviews, analyzes, and modifies programming systems including encoding, testing, debugging and documenting programs. May require a bachelor's degree. Requires 5 years or more of experience in the field or in a related area. Familiar with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures. Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Performs a variety of complicated tasks. May lead and direct the work of Contractor staff. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. 
 Experience with CSS, Data Modelling, Hibernate, J2ee, Java, JavaScript, JSP, Junit, PL/SQL, SQL. 
 
 


 Syed Mohammad Asif 
 408-775-7468
